create_model_pix2pixHD_training: create a Pix2PixHD training model by calling create_model with opt.model set to pix2pixHD and opt.isTrain true
create_model_pix2pixHD_inference: create a Pix2PixHD inference model by calling create_model with opt.model set to pix2pixHD and opt.isTrain false
create_model_ui: create a UIModel by calling create_model with opt.model set to anything other than pix2pixHD
create_model_multip gpu: create a multi-GPU Pix2PixHD model by passing opt.gpu_ids with a list of GPU device IDs
create_model_verbose: create a model with verbose output enabled by setting opt.verbose to true in the options object
